name: Azure
description: Your Azure tenants, subscriptions and resources in prifly, read through your connected Microsoft account: read-only tools for every session, a board to start a session from a resource or a failed deployment, and a status-bar chip. No az CLI needed.

connections.why: Reads your Azure tenants, subscriptions, resources, deployments, Activity Log and costs. Read-only: it changes nothing in Azure. Asked for only when you pick Grant Azure access on the board.

launch.label: From an Azure resource…
launch.description: Resources across your subscriptions, failed deployments first. The session starts knowing the resource, its recent deployments and its Activity Log. Granting access and switching subscription happen here too.
launch.searchPlaceholder: Filter by name, type, resource group, location or tag…

settings.label: Subscription to show
settings.description: Its name or id. Left empty, the board shows the one you last picked there, else the first enabled one.
